description: Browse the laws, statutes and accreditations the catalog tracks, each joined to the countries, regions and industries it binds. Filter by scope=horizontal to get the regimes that reach a provider with NO industry tag at all, which is the question tags alone cannot answer; or by kind (regulation/statute/accreditation/regulator-guidance) or jurisdiction. A null company_count means the job-corpus pass has not run for that name — it is NOT a measured zero.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

jurisdiction.description: Case-insensitive substring of the jurisdiction, e.g. "EU" or "United States".

kind.description: Kind of regime: regulation, statute, accreditation or regulator-guidance.

q.description: Free text matched against name and description, e.g. "payments".

scope.description: Regulation scope; "horizontal" returns regimes that bind regardless of industry.

name: find_regulations
